title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.18139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite edge computing distributes mobile workloads across moving processors whose service capacity must be coordinated over time. In medium Earth orbit (MEO)--low Earth orbit (LEO) networks, periodic reports leave CPU states stale or missing, making offloading sensitive to uncertain capacity and shared-destination congestion. We propose PUMA-Former, an uncertainty-aware agentic framework for cooperative offloading under incomplete information that balances completed work, service delay, and execution cost. A MEO coordinator maintains distinct-report memory and closes the loop between available evidence, capacity estimates, allocation commands, and execution feedback. Latent-delay attention weights plausible measurement-age hypotheses, and historical innovations refine CPU estimates around the latest received report. translated_title: PUMA-Former：不完备信息下中低轨（MEO-LEO）卫星网络中不确定性感知的智能体式计算卸载
translated_abstract: 卫星边缘计算将移动工作负载分布于不断移动的处理器之间，其服务能力需要随时间进行协调。在中地球轨道（MEO）-低地球轨道（LEO）网络中，周期性状态报告会导致CPU状态过时或缺失，使卸载决策对不确定的服务容量和共享目的地的拥塞十分敏感。我们提出PUMA-Former，这是一个在不完备信息下进行协作卸载的不确定性感知智能体框架，可平衡已完成工作量、服务延迟与执行成本。MEO协调器维护差异化的报告记忆，并在可用证据、容量估计、分配指令与执行反馈之间形成闭环。潜在延迟注意力机制对合理的测量时延假设进行加权，历史增量信息则围绕最新收到的报告对CPU估计进行细化。队列误差感知融合机制在考虑积压不确定性的同时纳入辅助压力信息。推断的资源…
tldr: 该论文提出PUMA-Former框架，在不完备信息条件下通过不确定性感知的智能体机制协调MEO-LEO卫星网络中的协作计算卸载，利用潜在延迟注意力与队列误差感知融合来平衡已完成工作量、服务延迟和执行成本。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes PUMA-Former, an uncertainty-aware agentic framework for cooperative computation offloading in MEO-LEO satellite networks under incomplete information, which leverages latent-delay attention and queue-error-aware fusion to balance completed work, service delay, and execution cost.
